answer_1.quote: We propose a novel disentangled template rewriting approach as the first attempt to study stylized knowledge‑grounded dialogue generation ... We conduct experiments on Wizard of Wikipedia and Topical Chat ... Human evaluation ... annotators judge which response is better from four aspects ...
answer_1.outputs: Generated dialogue responses in specified styles (positive, negative, polite) that are knowledge‑grounded

answer_2.quote: We use automatic metrics to measure DTR on three aspects: Style Intensity, Relevance, and Diversity. For style intensity, we use the GPT‑2 classifier prediction ... Relevance is measured with F1, BLEU and ROUGE. We use Distinct to measure Diversity of different models.

answer_4.quote: For human evaluation, we randomly sample 500 examples from test set, and recruit 3 well‑educated annotators. The annotators then judge which response is better from four aspects: (1) Style Consistency, (2) Knowledge Preservation, (3) Context Coherence, (4) Fluency.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare two responses and select the better one according to the four criteria listed above.
